DOP: bhakkha m. and mfn. 1. ( i ) ( m. ) [ S. bhakṣa], food; Pv 21:42 (dibbā ~ā pātubhaveyyuṃ sīlavanto ca yācakā); Ja II 14, 15* (dibbā ca te pātubhavantu ~ā; 14, 20´ : devatānaṃ paribhogārahā ~ā); III 151, 19´ (aññaṃ ca ~aṃ sīho khādati aññaṃ usabho ti); 481, 14 (mayhaṃ ~e nāsetvā āgatā sī ti); V 197, 6* (pajjaṃ ca ~aṃ ca paṭiccha dammi; 197, 10´ : ~an ti madhuraphalāphalaṃ); 255, 11* (~o cāyaṃ anappako); 465, 6* (bhutvā ~aṃ rasuttamaṃ; 466, 2´ : ~an ti khādaniyaṃ); 498, 10* (addhā hi so ~o mamaṃ manāpo); Ap 4, 30 (dibbā ~ā upenti maṃ); Mhv 7:13 (~o si mama tiṭṭhā ti); — ifc ( whose food is …, eating …) see kaṇa-, gūtha-, gomaya- ( sv go ), tiṇa-, daddula-, nīvāra-, piññāka-, phala- ( sv phala 2 ), maṃsa-; — ( ii ) ( mfn. ) eating; Mhv 34:14 (attano bhariyādinnaṃ visaṃ ~o mato kira, Ee so; line omitted in Be ); — 2. ( mfn. ) [ S. bhakṣya], to be eaten, eatable; fit for food; Ja III 328, 6* (tvaṃ ca māṇava bhikkhā ca ubho ~ā bhavissatha); V 71, 5* (~o ayaṃ manussānaṃ yathā c’ aññe vane migā; 73, 11´ : ~o ti khāditabbayuttako); 91, 2* (Sambule … alaṃ tvaṃ pātarāsāya maññe ~ā bhavissasi); 489, 26* (pañca pañca na khā bhakkhā khattiyena pajānatā); — abhakkha , mfn. , (what is) not to be eaten; not fit for food; Ja V 467, 13* (na tvaṃ arahasi tāta ~aṃ bhakkhayetave); 469, 24* (~aṃ rāja bhakkhesi); 489, 30´ (hatthi-ādayo das’ eva sattā maṃsavasena ~ā na khā bhakkhā na kho khāditabbayuttakā, Ce, Be so; Se ~ā na khāditabbayuttakā; Ee maṃsamayena na kho bhakkhā …); VI 63, 26* (na cāpi me Sīvalī so ~o; 64, 3´ : so piṇḍapāto mama ~o nāma na hoti); Spk I 133, 27 (aggissa hi ~aṃ nāma natthi).
CPD: a-bhakkha , m ( fn ). ( neg. grd. of √bhakkh; sa. a-bhakṣya), forbidden as food; Ja Vl 63, 26 * (na câpi me . . . so ~o; = so piṇḍapāto mama ~o nāma na hoti, Ct. ); -— ° -sammata , mfn., considered as a°; ° -bhāva , m. abstr. , Ja Vl 77, 9 (attano sarīramaṃ- sassa ~aṃ dassetuṃ . . . āha).

မျက်မှောင်ကြုတ်ခြင်း-သုန်မှုန်ခြင်း-မရှိသော၊ သူ။

[ from bhakuṭī̆, bhākuṭi 1 ], frowning, grimacing; (one) who habitually frowns or grimaces; Vism 26, 29 (bhākuṭikaraṇaṃ sīlaṃ assā ti ~o, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se bhakuṭikaraṇaṃ); — °- bhākuṭika , mfn. , continually frowning or grimacing; Vin III 181, 6 (kvāyaṃ abalabalo viya mandamando viya ~o viya; Sp 622, 21 foll.: bhakuṭiṃ katvā saṅkuṭitamukho kupito viya vicaratī ti, Be, Ce so; Ee kuṭitamukho; Se saṅkuñcitamukho); Nidd I 226, 27 (korajikakorajiko ~o kuhakakuhako; Nidd-a I 336, 28 : ~o ti ativiya mukhasaṅkocanasīlo) quoted Vism 26, 2 ; Ps II 147, 35 ; — abbhākuṭika , abhākuṭika, mfn. , not frowning; Vin III 181, 9 (mihitapubbaṅgamā ehisvāgatavādino ~ā; Sp 623, 6 : iminā bhākuṭikabhākuṭikākārassa abhāvo dassito); D I 116, 10 (samaṇo … Gotamo … ~o uttānamukho pubbabhāsī) ≠ Dhp-a IV 8, 13 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee abbhokuṭiko); Pj I 240, 10 (abhākuṭiko uttānamukho).
